searchText: hello, is zhejiang the last step before shanghai goes live? any roadmap/checklist for the shanghai upgrade? I assume that existing public testnets Goerli and Sepolia will be upgraded after Zhejiang testnet and before mainnet. The timeline will depend on what issues are found. We might hear more at the All Core Devs - Execution call this week. thank you! will check the call notes after hey guys 👋 where can i find the latest changes for shanghai and a compiled (finalized) list of changes for the hard fork? I'm trying to run shanghai on a local network and study the code changes. thanks! https://notes.ethereum.org/@launchpad/zhejiang

excerpts.author: abcoathup
excerpts.content:
I assume that existing public testnets Goerli and Sepolia will be upgraded after Zhejiang testnet and before mainnet. The timeline will depend on what issues are found. 

We might hear more at the All Core Devs - Execution call this week.
